I replied to Dana in our direct message that Dock 38 is now her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups. I said I'd keep it in that DM and not share it anywhere else. As she asked, I took no other action.

There's no tool here for saving a note, so the record of this is her message and my reply in that DM. I didn't save it to the shared memory files on purpose: other members' conversations can pull from those, and something told to me in a DM must stay out of other members' conversations.
